records.text: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees answered Him, saying, “Teacher, we wish to see a sign from Thee.”
He answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks a sign, but no sign will be given it except the sign of Jonah the prophet.
For just as Jonah was in the sea creature’s belly three days and three nights, so the Son of Man will be in the heart of the earth three days and three nights.
Men of Nineveh will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at Jonah’s proclamation; and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
As the crowds were gathering in greater numbers, He began to say, “This generation is an evil generation. It seeks a sign, and no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah.
For just as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

The queen of the south will be raised at the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, because she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and behold, something greater than Solomon is here.
The men of Nineveh will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the proclamation of Jonah, and behold, something greater than Jonah is here.
The birth pangs of death encompassed me, and torrents of lawlessness threw me into turmoil.
The birth pangs of Hades surrounded me; the traps of death overtook me.
And when I was afflicted, I called upon the Lord and cried out to my God. He heard my voice from His holy temple, and my cry before Him will enter His ears.
My soul was troubled within me; therefore I will remember Thee from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from a small mountain.
Deep calls upon deep at the sound of Thy waterfalls; all Thy billows and Thy waves passed over me.
By day the Lord will command His mercy, and at night a song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
Blessed be the Lord, because He made His mercy wonderful in an enclosed city.
But I said in my alarm, “So I have been cast away from before Thine eyes.” For this reason Thou heardest the voice of my petition when I cried unto Thee.
Love the Lord, all His holy ones, because the Lord seeks truths and repays those who act with abundant arrogance.
Act courageously, and let your heart be strong, all who hope in the Lord.
Save me, God, for waters have entered as far as my soul.
I was stuck in the mud of the depth, with no firm ground; I entered the sea’s depths, and a tempest drowned me.
I grew weary crying out; my throat became hoarse; my eyes failed from hoping in my God.
Sacrifice a sacrifice of praise to God and pay your vows to the Most High.
Call on Me in the day of affliction; I will rescue you, and you will glorify Me.” Diapsalma.
Rise, Lord! Save me, my God! For Thou didst strike all who were my enemies without cause; Thou didst crush sinners’ teeth.
Salvation belongs to the Lord, and Thy blessing is upon Thy people.
whatever prayer or supplication is made by any person, each knowing the affliction of his own heart and spreading his hands toward this house,

then hear from heaven, from Thy prepared dwelling place; be merciful, act, and give to each person according to his ways, as Thou knowest his heart, for Thou alone knowest the hearts of all the sons of humankind,
so that they may fear Thee all the days they live on the land Thou gavest our fathers.
The pangs of death surrounded me; the dangers of Hades found me; I found affliction and pain.
And I called on the name of the Lord: “O Lord, rescue my soul!”
Merciful is the Lord, and righteous; and our God shows mercy.
Blessed be the Lord, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
Our soul was rescued like a little bird from the trap of hunters; the trap was shattered, and we were rescued.
Our help is in the Lord’s name, who made heaven and earth.
